name: keepdeck-teams
description: Tells a Kimi Code session, at the moment it starts, that KeepDeck may have placed it on a team.
author: KeepDeck

interface.shortDescription: Lets a Kimi session find out it is on a KeepDeck team.
interface.longDescription: Kimi Code discards whatever a SessionStart hook prints, so the deck cannot tell a starting session anything through the reporter. A plugin session-start skill is the one door Kimi has, and this plugin is that door: it asks the session to read its own standing from KeepDeck before it starts working, so a teammate does not have to be messaged first to learn it has a role at all. Inert in any session where KeepDeck's tools are absent.
